title: Assembly is now Wavelength!
summary: The First AI-Native CRM purpose built for post-sales teams to track your customers’ journey from the moment they onboard till the day they expand.
body_markdown:
Think of it as having a team member who's read every email, attended every call, tracked every metric, and can instantly answer "how's this customer doing?" in plain English.


Wavelength automatically pulls signals from everywhere—CRM, support, product usage, conversations—and tells you what actually matters. No hunting across Slack threads. No stitching together context from five different tools. No manual updates.


It's the first AI-native customer platform that actually understands your customers, not just stores data about them.
